sources.title: ST AN4277 Rev9: filtering the break input
sources.finding: Switching noise can spuriously trigger Break; configurable filtering exists but must preserve protection timing.

sources.title: ST STM32G4 LL TIM header
sources.finding: BKF=3 corresponds to fSAMPLING=fCK_INT and N=8; installed local header matches.

sources.title: ST AN4694 EMC design guides, sections4.4.2.2 and5 item5
sources.finding: Finite shared return inductance and driver/controller ground connections can inject noise into logic and sensing even when a DC ground connection exists.

sources.title: STGIB15CH60TS-L DS10424 Rev10 section4 Table11
sources.finding: Typical internal fault-output hold is24us for short OC and70us for short UVLO, without additional SD RC. These are typical, not guaranteed minimum values.

sources.title: ST UM2014 sections4.3.1/4.3.2
sources.finding: SD is bidirectional, with R28=10k pullup and C20 restart network. External shutdown and module fault signaling share the net.

sources.title: STM32G431 ES0431 Rev9 sections2.3.1/2.4.4/2.7.1/2.8.5
sources.finding: The short-pulse bidirectional BKIN issue requires bidirectional mode; saved event BKBID=0. DMAMUX remapping issue has synchronization/reconfiguration preconditions absent in the normal configured recorder. No matched GPIO/DMA false-LOW root cause identified.

sources.title: ST Community: TIM1_BKIN noise immunity problem (2021)
sources.finding: Reports noise-triggered BKIN trips. Different MCU, and the discussed internal pullup is already enabled in our source; not an established fix for this stand.

sources.title: ST Community: SLLIMM2 low-voltage input signal injection (2026)
sources.kind: first-person forum report, different STGIF module, unanswered
sources.finding: Reports approximately100ns negative input spikes with an RC network. Relevant mechanism example, not proof or a validated solution.

sources.title: ST Community: Weird noise on ADC current sensing (2025)
sources.kind: first-person G431 FOC report and moderator guidance
sources.finding: ADC/PWM sampling timing and switching/ground interference discussed. Does not directly justify tuning a current regulator in our open-loop V/f path.

sources.title: ST Community: NUCLEO-F303RE + STEVAL-IPM15B (2019/2020)
sources.kind: first-person forum report, different MCU/FOC application
sources.finding: A user reports resolving startup overcurrent by PWM frequency and flux/torque regulator changes. Different control mode and trigger; not transplanted to the22Hz runtime fault.

sources.title: ST AN4277: Break implementation
sources.finding: BIF is not a unique physical-source identifier: system-level break requests can join external BKIN and comparator requests.

leading_hypothesis: Switching-related disturbance or local reference shift on the SD/BKIN path, with capture integrity still to be independently checked.
mechanism_supported_by_current_configura: BKF3 is an8-sample fast filter, approximately47ns at configured170MHz. A true0.4us pulse can pass; a one-point200ns DMA observation does not measure its true analog width.
other_candidates: A true module OC/UVLO assertion truncated/misrepresented by measurement
Unqualified phase-current or V/f operating condition creating a real power-stage fault
evidence_against_simple_crc_cause: The run retained CRC/sequence/dropped/transport counters at0; MC_DP_FAULT0x400 and BIF were recorded.
temperature_interpretation: Primary software temperature fault was not recorded. Module documentation lists OC/UVLO for SD;52C cached sensor data cannot independently qualify die temperature or all heat-induced failure mechanisms.

local_audit.CSS_interpretation: Normal replies continued after fault, inconsistent with a persistent CSS NMI entering the linked default handler; no event-time CSS flag was captured, so not a complete hardware exclusion.

measurement_decision: If endpoint discrepancy is independently observed: investigate interconnect, reference and probe influence before any filter change.
If long module SD assertion is observed: distinguish VCC/UVLO from CIN/OC with qualified measurements; duration alone is insufficient.
If BIF occurs without verified external LOW: inspect event-time AF1/AF2 and system Break flags, plus recorder service timing.
Auxiliary-only Saleae capture tests the route and instrumentation; absence of a fault there cannot validate powered22Hz operation.
pending_operator_preparation_not_confirm: J1 physically unplugged after bus discharge; Saleae CH6 PA6/CN10-13, CH7 STEVAL TP23, GND CN7-19; boards powerbanks and J4off. Do not assume user completed this just because they requested research.
